description: This file defines the OAuthService class which manages OAuth 2.0 authorization flows, including client retrieval, authorization code generation, token exchange, refresh token handling, and error mapping. It interacts with repositories for clients, codes, and teams, and handles PKCE validation and JWT token creation.

classes.name: OAuthService
classes.description: A service class handling OAuth 2.0 authorization, token issuance, refresh, and error mapping.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth client details by client ID.

methods.name: getClientForAuthorization
methods.description: Fetches client info and validates redirect URI and access permissions for authorization.

methods.name: generateAuthorizationCode
methods.description: Generates an authorization code after validating client and scopes, handling PKCE and team access.

methods.name: exchangeCodeForTokens
methods.description: Exchanges an authorization code for access and refresh tokens, validating client, code, and PKCE.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes tokens using a valid refresh token, validating client and token integrity.

methods.name: buildRedirectUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL with query parameters for redirects.

methods.name: buildErrorRedirectUrl
methods.description: Builds a redirect URL with error details for OAuth error responses.

methods.name: mapErrorToOAuthError
methods.description: Maps internal errors to OAuth-compliant error objects.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates client secret for confidential clients.

methods.name: verifyPKCE
methods.description: Verifies PKCE code challenge and method during token exchange.

methods.name: generateAuthorizationCodeString
methods.description: Generates a secure random string for authorization codes.

methods.name: createTokens
methods.description: Creates access and refresh tokens with JWT, including payloads and expiration.

methods.name: verifyRefreshToken
methods.description: Verifies and decodes a refresh token JWT.
